run.question:
Alertmanager alert KubePodNotReady (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq since 2026-11-25T19:16:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is explained by a bad container image set on the checkout Deployment: pod otel-demo/checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq was created at 19:15:36 by ReplicaSet checkout-7ffc7768f4 (created by Deployment checkout revision 2) with container image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64:2.0.0@sha256:20c6ce98..., and the kubelet cannot pull it: "not found" (ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff). The container never started, so the pod stays Pending and Ready=False, which keeps kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true"}=0 and fires KubePodNotReady. The pod is the only non-ready pod in otel-demo; the previous ReplicaSet checkout-64c65899fc keeps one ready pod running the correct image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:3.1.0-checkout), and checkout spans continued through the window with no error status, so no application-level failure of checkout was observed in this sample. The Deployment object holds the faulty image setting (manager "OpenAPI-Generator" last Updated it at 19:15:36); who or what issued that update is unknown because change history is not integrated.

claims.text: Pod otel-demo/checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq is Pending with phase startTime 2026-11-25T19:15:36Z; its container "checkout" is in state waiting with reason ImagePullBackOff for image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64:2.0.0@sha256:20c6ce98bea7470d39364356ec0a8482fa7356ac92e132256539417688da615a" (ErrImagePull: rpc error code = NotFound ... not found); Pod Ready=False and ContainersReady=False with reason ContainersNotReady; restartCount 0 and empty lastState.

kubelet events for pod checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq record "Failed to pull image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64:2.0.0@sha256:20c6ce98...": rpc error: code = NotFound ... not found (5 occurrences, 19:15:38Z-19:18:42Z), "Error: ErrImagePull" (5), "Back-off pulling image ..." (19, 19:16:06Z-19:20:39Z) and "Error: ImagePullBackOff" (19, 19:16:06Z-19:20:39Z).

Deployment otel-demo/checkout (revision annotation "2") has spec.template container "checkout" image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64:2.0.0@sha256:20c6ce98... and status replicas=2, readyReplicas=1, unavailableReplicas=1, updatedReplicas=1, with condition Progressing reason ReplicaSetUpdated; its managedFieldsSummary shows helm Apply at 2026-11-25T19:08:09Z, manager "OpenAPI-Generator" Update at 2026-11-25T19:15:36Z, and kube-controller-manager status Update at 2026-11-25T19:15:36Z.

ReplicaSet checkout-7ffc7768f4 (owner Deployment checkout) was created 2026-11-25T19:15:36Z with the nonexistent hello-bench image and has no ready replicas; the older ReplicaSet checkout-64c65899fc (same owner) uses image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:3.1.0-checkout and still has readyReplicas=1.

Deployment/ReplicaSet events show the rollout that produced the failing pod: Deployment checkout "Scaled up replica set checkout-7ffc7768f4 from 0 to 1" at 19:15:36Z and ReplicaSet checkout-7ffc7768f4 "Created pod: checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq" at 19:15:36Z (Normal SuccessfulCreate), alongside the earlier 19:08:09Z scale-up of checkout-64c65899fc.

kube_pod_status_ready for checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq has condition="true" = 0 at every sample from 19:16:00Z to 19:21:00Z and condition="false" = 1, while checkout-64c65899fc-mglqt has condition="true" = 1 over the same samples.
At 19:21:00Z the only series in namespace otel-demo with kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true"} == 0 is pod checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq; the other otel-demo pods are ready.

kube_pod_container_info at 19:21:00Z lists container checkout of pod checkout-64c65899fc-mglqt with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:3.1.0-checkout and image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:d4448ff541290fc57cca71d4bfd35d522959edf62a8bb55158467583f9fad4e2, and container checkout of pod checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq with image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64:2.0.0@sha256:20c6ce98... and no image_id or container_id (image never pulled/started).

Across all 47 deployments in the cluster, otel-demo/checkout is the only one whose pod template references the hello-bench image, and among the 26 otel-demo deployments it is the only one with unavailable replicas > 0.

The otel-demo ConfigMap flagd-config holds 18 demo flags (including failedReadinessProbe, imageSlowLoad, cartFailure, paymentFailure, adFailure) and every one has defaultVariant "off"; the namespace's other ConfigMaps are agent-fixtures, kube-root-ca.crt, otel-collector, postgresql-init and product-catalog-product-catalog-otel-config, none holding a checkout image or image-injection setting.

The failing pod's application container never produced logs: the log read reports "container checkout ... is waiting to start: trying and failing to pull image", and the only line read is the init container wait-for-kafka message "kafka (10.96.146.230:9092) open" at 2026-11-25T19:15:37Z.

checkout service span activity continued over 18:21:29Z-19:21:29Z with no ERROR status: sums of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout"} show oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder ~368 spans, POST ~1105, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert ~1052 and other operations, all with status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and no checkout series with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR was returned for 19:01:29Z-19:21:29Z.

Rejected: a general registry/network pull outage. The error text is a manifest-level NotFound for that specific digest, and other images pulled successfully on the same node in the same window (busybox:latest for the init container at 19:15:37Z, and the previous checkout image was already present on the machine).

Rejected: a flagd-injected fault (e.g. failedReadinessProbe or imageSlowLoad) as the trigger. All flagd-config flags have defaultVariant "off", and the container failed at image pull, before any probe or application code ran.

Rejected: scheduling or node-resource pressure. The pod was Scheduled at 19:15:36Z on kind-environment-worker and its init container started and completed its check at 19:15:37Z, so only the image pull for container checkout failed.

Rejected: a readiness/liveness probe misconfiguration on a running container. Container checkout has restartCount 0, an empty lastState and state waiting (ImagePullBackOff), so no probe ever ran against this pod.

An external automation/actor changed the checkout Deployment's pod template image at 19:15:36Z to a non-existent benchmark image (quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64:2.0.0@sha256:20c6ce98...); the API-side writer recorded is "OpenAPI-Generator". This is consistent with the rollout, the pull NotFound and the missing manifests, but the actor and its intent are not observable with the available sources.

Set Deployment otel-demo/checkout container checkout back to a pullable image (the previously working ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:3.1.0-checkout, image_id sha256:d4448ff541290fc57cca71d4bfd35d522959edf62a8bb55158467583f9fad4e2) or publish the intended image/digest in quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64, then let the rollout replace pod checkout-7ffc7768f4-5cdfq; also audit which identity uses the "OpenAPI-Generator" manager field to update otel-demo workloads.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so what changed the checkout Deployment image at 2026-11-25T19:15:36Z (manager field "OpenAPI-Generator") and who issued it could not be verified.
The failing container never started, so there are no application logs from it; only the init container's single log line was readable.
Events returned cover only 2026-11-25T18:36:38Z-19:20:39Z; cluster state before that, and any event that expired, is unknown.

The endpoint of the alert annotation "non-ready for longer than 15 minutes" could not be reconciled with the pod's own timeline (created 19:15:36Z, ready=false from the first 19:16:00Z sample); Alertmanager's own alert state history was not queried.

Error spans counted for ad, flagd, fraud-detection, payment and recommendation (~1.2 per 20 minutes each) were not examined further and were not compared with a pre-incident baseline, so their relation to this incident is unknown.
The impact of the stuck rollout on future availability of the checkout Deployment (e.g. if the remaining ready pod checkout-64c65899fc-mglqt were lost) was not observed.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind. When the API server returns zero objects of a kind other than events (every page read), the result is ok with total_items_processed 0: it proves only that there were no objects matching this kind, namespace and selectors at query time, not that none existed during the incident. Zero events, or a list your filter reduced to nothing, stays no_data. metadata.managedFieldsSummary gives each manager's last write time only: it is not a full change history (earlier writes by the same manager are gone) and it does not say which fields that write changed.
